title: Floor pump
object: Bicycle floor pump in axial section
idea: Positive-displacement compression through two one-way valves
summary: Boyle's law in a barrel. The cup seal folds in on the upstroke because it is the inlet valve; the check ball lifts when the chamber passes tyre pressure because it is the outlet. The P–s diagram flattens the moment the valve opens.
usedFor: Physics teaching: Boyle's law, dead volume, compression ratio
Product documentation for pumps and compressors
controls: Drag the handle · Space pumps · R lets the tyre down · S slow motion
